business_problem: deinePflege's medically trained support staff was spending too much time on routine care-box and application questions, even as paper-heavy healthcare workflows and rising demand made 24/7 service impossible to staff economically.
solution_summary: deinePflege is using Agentforce to convert repetitive care-support work into authenticated, around-the-clock digital service. Customer cases, contact history, and operational content live in Service Cloud and Data Cloud, letting Agentforce verify eligibility, answer questions about in-home care, and guide customers through next steps in seconds instead of forcing medically trained reps to complete each workflow by hand. When a request crosses into sensitive territory, the agent hands the interaction to a human rep together with the full conversation context so customers do not repeat themselves. The same design is being extended to WhatsApp, email, and voice, while the Einstein Trust Layer and strict authentication protect regulated health information. Agent Builder gives the team a low-code way to refine actions, helping deinePflege scale service without rebuilding its support architecture.

solution_components.name: Agentforce
solution_components.role: Handles common support conversations and guides customers through approved next steps.

solution_components.name: Service Cloud
solution_components.role: Stores contact history and service context used during support interactions.

solution_components.name: Data Cloud
solution_components.role: Holds FAQs, documents, and care-offering data that the agent reasons across.

solution_components.name: Einstein Trust Layer
solution_components.role: Protects regulated customer data with masking and zero-retention safeguards.

solution_components.name: Agent Builder
solution_components.role: Lets the team configure and refine support agents with low-code tools.

data_flow: Email and phone requests enter Service Cloud, where Agentforce combines contact history with FAQ, document, and offering data from Data Cloud. Authenticated answers are delivered immediately, sensitive cases are handed to reps with context, and the same model is being extended to WhatsApp, email, and voice channels.
business_outcome: deinePflege expects faster access to care support, lower case-handling costs, and more staff time for counseling and medically complex work instead of repetitive case administration.
metrics: 80% of applications still arrive by fax

average resolution cost per case from $17 to just $2

Hand-offs preserve full conversational context for human support reps.
